content: AlphaStar's Prioritized Fictitious Self-Play (PFSP) samples opponents with probability proportional to their win rate AGAINST the main agent (i.e. weighted toward opponents the agent is currently worst against) -- directly analogous to this project's inverse-success defense weighting. AlphaStar mitigates catastrophic forgetting via a diverse persistent league (old checkpoints stay sampleable forever) plus experience replay, not by ever fully retiring an opponent.
